description: This file defines the InterfaceEngine class implementing the GenericEngine interface, primarily providing methods that throw exceptions indicating interface services cannot be invoked, and empty callback methods.

classes.name: InterfaceEngine
classes.description: A class implementing the GenericEngine interface, providing methods related to service invocation and callbacks, with most methods throwing exceptions indicating interface services cannot be invoked.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Attempts to run a service synchronously; throws exception indicating interface services cannot be invoked.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Attempts to run a service synchronously ignoring results; throws exception indicating interface services cannot be invoked.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Attempts to run a service asynchronously; throws exception indicating interface services cannot be invoked.

methods.description: Empty method for sending callbacks with mode parameter.
